posts.title: Subscribing to ARD Sounds podcasts via RSS
posts.description: To liberate podcasts from the German ARD Sounds app, use this neat open-source tool by Sebastian Cohnen (tisba): https://ardsounds.tisba.de I came across this on Mastodon, heard about it again in the Wochendämmerung podcast, and used it to subscribe to the Kult! podcast (German audio books of classical literature) upon a recommendation by blumenstrasse who plugged […]

posts.title: Marc Andreessen, venture capitalist, married to … wait, what?
posts.description: Adrian Daub's recent book got me thinking about Silicon Valley's history. Its origins predate the age of Information Technology, and yet they still structure the Valley – as shown in a very curious marriage.

posts.title: Why I switched from LaTeX to typst for presentations (It’s not the looks)
posts.description: For the past two summers, I have been teaching parts of a computer science course to undergraduates. The professor is teaching the theory of computer architecture and operating systems and I do the hands-on exercise part. This summer, I decided to switch to typst for my slide sets. Here is why.
